taczscopeglint.configuration.title: TaCZ Scope Glint Settings
taczscopeglint.configuration.minZoomThre: Only optical scopes marked TaCZ scope=true with current zoom strictly above this threshold can glint. Collimator/red-dot/holographic sights without this flag never glint, regardless of ADS zoom. Default: 1.5x
taczscopeglint.configuration.glintVisibl: Maximum distance (blocks) at which other players see the scope glint. Default: 128
taczscopeglint.configuration.updateNotic: Show a clickable update notice once per game launch.
